meta.case: Porto Batel reef, regular swell on the 236 deg line (illustrative 2D slice)
meta.label: illustrative 2D slice
meta.frame_origin: x_m east / y_m north of 39.322 N, -9.3625 E (M_PER_DEG 111195), as reefs.json

fields.s_cm: distance from the house along the bearing (cm); first frame absolute
fields.ds_cm: change of s_cm since the previous frame (cm); later frames
fields.z_cm: height above LAT (cm); first frame absolute
fields.dz_cm: change of z_cm since previous frame
fields.surface_cm: free surface height above LAT (cm) every 1 m of surface_s_m; null where dry

notes: 2D simulation (WCSPH) on one line through the 2011 lidar (11 x 14 m grid, interpolated between cells); no refraction or alongshore variation; the paddle-out channel is missing
particles are a fixed random subset; the same index is the same particle in every frame
profile position uncertain by about one grid cell (9-12 m)
